name: Hooded vulture & tawny eagle
description: A small scavenger and a powerful bird of prey. Functional group pooling the source's 'hooded vulture' node: the hooded vulture (Necrosyrtes monachus) and the tawny eagle (Aquila rapax), grouped by the source study; the eagle accounts for the live prey (rodents, snakes) in this node's diet.
